newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: YPF shr sale price Tuesday-Argentine bank.
newsitem.headline: YPF shr sale price Tuesday-Argentine bank.

text.p: The cut-off price for the auction of 10 percent of the shares of Argentine oil firm YPF will be announced at 1015 local time (0915 New York) Tuesday, an executive for a local bank handling the auction said Monday.

Banco Comafi and MBA in Argentina and Salomon Brothers in New York have been accepting bids for the shares since 1700 local time Monday and will continue to do so until 0700 local time Tuesday, Banco Comafi spokesman Enrique Mendez told Reuters.
"Demand for the local part of the auction has been much greater than expected," Mendez said.
Argentina's government authorized the sale of the 33.5 million Class C YPF shares in the hands of the company's employees --10 percent of the firm's stock -- by a decree issued last Friday.
The government owns another 20 percent of the firm but says it has no immediate plans to sell.
